node_5.subject: Rajiv Patel
node_5.description: This is Rajiv Patel's plan for Monday February 13: wake up and complete the morning routine at 7:00 am, wake up and complete the morning routine at 7:00 am, have breakfast at 7:30 am, commute to school from 8:00 am to 8:30 am, work at the office from 8:30 am to 12:30 pm, have lunch at 12:30 pm, work at the office from 1:30 pm to 5:00 pm, organize plans for the football match from 5:00 pm to 5:30 pm, have dinner at 5:30 pm, play billiards in the sports room from 6:30 pm to 7:30 pm, take a walk on the islands from 7:30 pm to 8:30 pm, watch TV from 9:00 pm to 11:30 pm, go to bed at midnight.
